11 digital tables from chapter VI. Text can be searched, copied, and edited after importing into the world. Page references refer to the supplied French edition. The English text is a translation of that edition; official wording should be checked against an English book.

The draw button opens a dialog for a modifier: 0, 5, 10, 20… The system rolls 1d100 + modifier. The total may exceed 100 and 150: the last entry covers 151+. Bonuses are not automatically taken from a character sheet. Apply the result manually. Do not normalize the ranges.

pages.name: 6-2 · Spending Advantage and Triumph in combat

text.content:
Source: French core book, table 6-2, printed p. 206 (PDF 217). English translation of the supplied French text. Dice use the system icons.

CostOptions
1 or 1
  • Recover 1 strain (this option may be selected more than once).
  • Add 1 to the next allied active character’s check.
  • Notice an important detail of the ongoing conflict, such as the location of a blast door control panel or a weak point on an attack speeder.
  • Inflict 1 Critical Injury with a successful attack that deals damage exceeding the target’s soak (variable Advantage cost).
  • Activate a weapon quality (variable Advantage cost).
2 or 1
  • Immediately perform a free maneuver (without exceeding the limit of two maneuvers per turn).
  • Add 1 to the targeted character’s next check.
  • Add 1 to the next check of any allied character, including the active character.
3 or 1
  • Negate the targeted enemy’s defensive bonuses (such as defense from cover, equipment, or the guarded stance maneuver) until the end of the current round.
  • Ignore adverse environmental effects, such as bad weather, zero gravity, or similar hindrances, until the end of the active character’s next turn.
  • When a target takes damage, the attack disables the opponent or a piece of their equipment instead of inflicting wounds or strain. Examples include a shot to the leg that hinders movement or a jammed comlink. The GM and player must agree, with the GM choosing the effects (the Critical Injury table may provide ideas). These effects should be temporary and moderate.
  • Gain +1 melee or ranged defense until the end of the active character’s next turn.
  • The target drops a held melee or ranged weapon.
1
  • Upgrade the difficulty of the targeted character’s next check once.
  • Upgrade the next check of any allied character, including the active character, once.
  • Perform a crucial action to turn the tide of battle, such as shooting a blast door control panel to close the doors.
2
  • When a target takes damage, the attack destroys one piece of their equipment, for example by exploding their blaster or severing their personal shield generator.

pages.name: 6-3 · Spending Threat and Despair in combat

text.content:
Source: French core book, table 6-3, printed p. 207 (PDF 218). English translation of the supplied French text. Dice use the system icons.

CostOptions
1 or 1
  • The active character suffers 1 strain (this option may be selected more than once).
  • The active character loses all benefits of a previously performed maneuver (such as taking cover or guarded stance) until they perform it again.
2 or 1
  • An opponent may immediately perform a free maneuver in response to the active character’s check.
  • Add 1 to the targeted character’s next check.
  • The active character or an allied character adds 1 to their next action.
3 or 1
  • The active character falls prone.
  • The active character gives their enemy an advantage during the current encounter (for example, accidentally destroying the controls of a bridge they intended to use to escape).
1
  • The character’s ranged weapon immediately runs out of ammunition and cannot be used for the rest of the encounter.
  • Upgrade the difficulty of the next check of an allied character, including the active character, once.
  • The tool or melee weapon the character is using is damaged (French edition, p. 159).

Source: French core book, table 6-10, printed p. 217 (PDF 228). English translation of the supplied French text. Dice use the system icons.

1d100SeverityNameResult
01–05Easy (1 )Minor NickThe target suffers 1 strain.
06–10Easy (1 )Slowed DownAt their next turn, the target may only act during the last allied initiative slot.
11–15Easy (1 )Sudden JoltThe target drops whatever they are holding.
16–20Easy (1 )DistractedThe target cannot perform a free maneuver during their next turn.
21–25Easy (1 )Off-BalanceThe target adds 1 to their next skill check.
26–30Easy (1 )Discouraging WoundFlip one light side Destiny Point to its dark side (reverse this for an NPC).
31–35Easy (1 )StunnedThe target is staggered until the end of their next turn.
36–40Easy (1 )StingerThe target adds 1 to their next check.
41–45Average (2 )Bowled OverThe target falls prone and suffers 1 strain.
46–50Average (2 )Head RingerThe target adds 1 to all Intellect and Cunning checks until the end of the encounter.
51–55Average (2 )Fearsome WoundThe target adds 1 to all Presence and Willpower checks until the end of the encounter.
56–60Average (2 )Agonizing WoundThe target adds 1 to all Brawn and Agility checks until the end of the encounter.
61–65Average (2 )Slightly DazedThe target is disoriented until the end of the encounter.
66–70Average (2 )Scattered SensesThe target removes all from their skill checks until the end of the encounter.
71–75Average (2 )HamstrungThe target loses their free maneuver until the end of the encounter.
76–80Average (2 )OverpoweredThe target leaves an opening, immediately granting the attacker a free attack against them with the same dice pool as the triggering attack.
81–85Average (2 )WindedUntil the end of the encounter, the target cannot voluntarily suffer strain to activate an ability or gain additional maneuvers.
86–90Average (2 )CompromisedThe target adds 1 to all skill checks until the end of the encounter.
91–95Hard (3 )At the BrinkThe target suffers 1 strain each time they perform an action.
96–100Hard (3 )CrippledOne of the target’s limbs (chosen by the GM) is impaired until healed or replaced. The target adds 1 to all checks involving that limb.
101–105Hard (3 )MaimedThe target permanently loses a limb (chosen by the GM). Without a cybernetic replacement, they cannot perform actions involving it. All their other actions receive 1 .
106–110Hard (3 )Horrific InjuryRoll 1d10 to determine a characteristic: 1–3 Brawn, 4–6 Agility, 7 Intellect, 8 Cunning, 9 Presence, 10 Willpower. Until this Critical Injury is healed, that characteristic is reduced by 1.
111–115Hard (3 )Temporarily LameUntil this Critical Injury is healed, the target cannot perform more than one maneuver during their turn.
116–120Hard (3 )BlindedThe target loses their sight. Upgrade the difficulty of all their checks twice (three times for Perception and Vigilance checks).
121–125Hard (3 )Knocked SenselessThe target is staggered until the end of the encounter.
126–130Daunting (4 )Gruesome InjuryRoll 1d10 to determine a characteristic: 1–3 Brawn, 4–6 Agility, 7 Intellect, 8 Cunning, 9 Presence, 10 Willpower. Permanently reduce that characteristic by 1, to a minimum of 1.
131–140Daunting (4 )Bleeding OutAt the start of their turn each round, the target suffers 1 wound and 1 strain. They suffer a Critical Injury for every five wounds taken beyond their wound threshold. Roll on this table; if this result is rolled again, reroll.
141–150Daunting (4 )The End is NighThe target will die after the last initiative slot of the next round.
151+-DeadIrreversible death.
